metadata.rule: 20-bar close breakout + taker-buy imbalance +/-0.30 + volume >=1.5x prior-20 median; entry next bar open; stop 1.5 ATR14; target 2R; timeout 10/20 bars; resolve against original 1m OHLC, stop-first ties
metadata.baselines: prior completed bar direction uses close[i-1] vs close[i-2] before signal bar i; always-up and always-down are reported separately
metadata.overlap: per symbol, one mutually exclusive long-or-short event at a time, chronological greedy non-overlap by forecast interval; outcomes not used for selection
metadata.leverage: not applied to PnL; labels only denote stop-distance eligibility (risk/entry < 1/leverage - 0.5%). No margin, liquidation, funding, spread, or slippage model.
metadata.minute_data: higher-timeframe bars require aligned complete minute buckets; trade paths with missing 1m rows are excluded
